next: 16.2.11 — pinned exact (root package.json#pnpm.overrides.next must stay aligned — F2 rule). Updated 2026-07-27 from 16.2.6 (Snyk app report, founder-relayed): clears the CVE-2026-6464x batch of 8 advisories. The ONE with a verified-applicable attack path here was CVE-2026-64641 (Server-Action $ACTION_REF_ CPU DoS — we ship a prod Server Action, the investor-room gate); the other 7 were verified not-exploitable in our deployment (Vercel-managed host pinning kills the SSRF pair; redirects are static internal paths; Server Actions run nodejs not edge; no cached attacker-body POST fetches; no fetch(new Request(),init) shape; Vercel-hosted excludes the image-optimizer SVG path; actions authenticate inside the boundary). Transitives noted: sharp stays 0.34.5 via next's pin (RISK-ACCEPTED — our code never imports sharp; it touches repo-owned assets at build time only, prod image-opt is Vercel-platform-side; re-check when next bumps to sharp 0.35.x); postcss@8.4.31 override bumped to 8.5.18 (SNYK-JS-POSTCSS-18313038 traversal — build-time-only exposure, our own CSS). Prior 16.2.6 note (2026-05-30, CVE-2026-45109 + CVE-2026-44576) retired — those fixes are carried forward. Monitor for 16.3.x stable.
